SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.imports imp ON f.file_id = imp.file_id
JOIN code.calls c ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
  AND s.kind = 'function'
  AND s.name = 'redirects'
  AND c.call_kind = 'callback'
  AND c.confidence = 'low'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM code.symbols client
               WHERE client.file_id = f.file_id
                 AND client.name = 'AsyncClient'
                 AND client.kind = 'class')
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.call_id) > 0

SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.imports imp ON f.file_id = imp.file_id
JOIN code.calls c ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
  AND s.kind = 'function'
  AND s.name = 'redirects'
  AND c.call_kind = 'callback'
  AND c.confidence = 'low'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
               FROM code.symbols client
               WHERE client.file_id = f.file_id
                 AND client.name = 'AsyncClient'
                 AND client.kind = 'class')
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.call_id) > 0
